revisions_tested: unknown: not run on a board yet

console.uart: the XDS110 backchannel (the probe's second serial port, /dev/cu.usbmodem<serial>1 on a Mac)

items.label: Time between lines
items.note: the line counts up each time

params.region: the last 2 kB sector below the security firmware; one sector write through the chip's mailbox, then a reset

elf.note: stripped; the .hex was made from the unstripped ELF

config.origin: the CCFG the SDK's SysConfig built into the ELF (CRCs filled by the SDK's crc_tool); not compared with a board yet

expect: prints "> Hello from my LaunchPad N" on the backchannel UART at 115200 baud every period_ms, N counting; LED0 toggles with each line; frl_status.counter = N
release_note: Built from TI's drivers/empty example (BSD-3-Clause, NOTICE.txt) plus our frl_demo.c. Not cleared for public distribution.
